items.name: MacBook Pro 16" M4 Max
items.description: I loved Linux for years, but switched to macOS for a rock-solid system. The M4 Max chip is purely about raw performance.

items.name: iPad Pro 13" M4 Pro
items.description: I love having a dual display, but didn't want a standalone monitor — I wanted a tablet for drawing and shaping 3D models for my printer.

items.name: Mac Mini M4 Pro
items.description: I run Vibe Kanban on it and use it as a home server. Best investment to date.

items.name: Iqunix MQ80
items.description: A mechanical keyboard with a satisfying typing experience. Black and red like my setup :)

items.name: Pixel 10 Pro
items.description: Always been on Android, don't plan to switch. Been loving the Pixel experience ever since the open-source days.

items.name: VsCode
items.description: Tried Cursor, Neovim, and others, but I keep coming back to VsCode.

items.name: Ghostty
items.description: I tried Alacritty, but I just love Ghostty — also made by the GOAT, Hashimoto!

items.name: Figma
items.description: Been a Figma fan since the early days. Now I'm using it to bridge design and development through their great MCP server.

items.name: Raycast
items.description: Best app launcher for macOS, hands down.

items.name: Claude Code
items.description: Best companion for coding, can't imagine working without it. AI is a total game changer — it 10x's my productivity every day!

items.name: Chrome
items.description: Tried so much alternatives, but Chrome is simply the best.

items.name: Vibe Kanban
items.description: Great tool to manage parallel work across multiple repositories. I use it for both personal and professional projects.
